title: Letters reach only some taxpayers
hook: Two stated cases: explore the reachable population in a stated response funnel.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the reachable population in a stated response funnel affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Purchases, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the reachable population in a stated response funnel in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Of 1000 toy visitors, fraction 0.7 stop and fraction 0.3 of those buy. How many purchases are expected?
